releaseNotes: Expands the balanced theological comparison library from 20 to 25 topics. New guides address original sin and ancestral sin, sanctification and holiness, divorce and pastoral care, Scripture and church authority, and Christian engagement with government and public life. Each comparison presents shared convictions, representative interpretations, historical context, areas of disagreement and pastoral reading cautions. Scripture references are validated against the complete offline KJV. Refreshes the offline cache.
